title: Overhead Sign Structure Tubular Structural Frame Details - 1
summary: Sheet S-2 of 5 of the LADOT overhead sign structure standard drawings. It shows the elevation of a tubular post with W6 x 12 sign support arms at 6 ft maximum spacing and an optional luminaire arm, plus corner, arm splice, cantilever arm connection and sign support arm bolt details. A design luminaire table lists three structure sizes by sign length (10-20 ft, 20-30 ft, 30-40 ft) with 2, 3 or 4 LED modules.

sheets.notes:
Section A (elevation, scale 1 1/2" = 1'-0")
Luminaire support arm 4'-0" long, 1'-2" below the top. Luminaires and luminaire support arms as required.
W6 x 12 sign support arm @ 6' max spacing.
Dimensions SH and SH/2 shown for post height.

Design luminaire
Style: MAQ-A120-7-LED-E1-SW-GM-DM-RD or equivalent. Projected area 3.3 FT2. Weight 60 lbs.
Structure 1: sign length 10' - 20', 2 LED.
Structure 2: sign length 20' - 30', 3 LED.
Structure 3: sign length 30' - 40', 4 LED.

I7 Corner detail (scale 3" = 1'-0")
Full depth 1/4" plate stiffener each side of web (clip corners for zinc drain). W6 x 12. Provide 1" dia hole for conduit. 1" dia cope. Extend top flange of horizontal member as shown or add 1/4" plate each side of web. CJP, backgouge.

I10 Arm splice detail (scale 3" = 1'-0")
Luminaire support arm if luminaire is required. W6 x 12. Always provide plate on sign support arm. Top of sign.

I14 Section B (scale 3" = 1'-0")
7/16" dia hole for 5/8" dia class 5 or greater bolt (not provided with luminaire). 6" x 9" x 1/4" plate. 1" dia hole. Cope bottom flange of W6 x 12. Dimensions shown: 1 1/2", 5", 1" CL typ, 8 1/2", 3 1/2".

E7 Cantilever arm connection (scale 3" = 1'-0")
5/8" dia x (Wa + 4 1/2") threaded rod, typ. W6 x 12 sign support arm. C6 x 10.5. 4 - 1/2" dia x HS bolts with nut and hardened washer. Dimensions: Wa + 5/8", 3".

E13 Section C (scale 3" = 1'-0")
Sign support arm. 1/2" plate sign support.

A13 Section G (scale 3" = 1'-0")
4 - 5/8" dia x WA + 4 1/2" threaded rods (double nut each rod). 5/8" thick rectangular washers w/ 2 - 11/16" dia holes. Sign support arm. C6 x 10.5 w/ 4 - 11/16" x 1" slotted holes.

A1 Section D (scale 3" = 1'-0")
1/2" x 5/8" dia holes for 5/8" dia x HS bolt with nut and hardened washer, 4 places. 1" dia hole for conduit. Dimensions 5" and 2".

A5 Section E (scale 3" = 1'-0")
Install sign support arm in vertical position. 1/2" thick plate. 8" dia bolt circle. 9/16" x 11/16" slots on 8" dia bolt circle symmetrical about plate CL. Sign support arm.

A9 Section F (scale 3" = 1'-0")
1/2" thick plate. C6 x 10.5. 8" dia bolt circle. 9/16" x 11/16" slots on 8" dia bolt circle symmetrical about plate CL. 1" dia hole for conduit. Sign support arm.

City of Los Angeles Department of Transportation. Overhead Sign Structure Standard Drawings. Tubular Structural Frame Details - 1. S-99.0. Sheet S-2 of 5.

title: Backplates
summary: Signal head backplate shapes for one-section through five-section vertical heads and multi-section cluster heads, with a 2-inch yellow retroreflective strip around the border. Width dimension A is 5 inches typical and corner radius R is 2 inches typical. Notes cover nominal 1/8 inch ABS construction, flange, finish and Type XI retroreflective sheeting.

sheets.notes:
Drawing shows backplate outlines for signal heads with one, two, three, four and five vertical sections, a three-section head with a larger lower section, and clustered five-section and three-section heads. 2-inch yellow retroreflective strip. Dimensions A and R, typ.

Notes:
1. The width dimension, "A" should be 5" typ. and the corner radius dimension, "R", should be 2" typ. The backplate shall have a nominal thickness of 1/8". All outside and inside edges shall be formed with a 1/2" to 5/8" flange (inside dimension), turned away from the front surface.
2. For all manufactured signal heads, backplates shall be designed so as to show no background light between the backplate and the head. The fabrication shall be vacuum formed as one piece with a black lusterless, haircell finish on the front side. All surfaces shall be flat and straight without blisters, buckling or warping. Flanges shall be straight, uniform and have a consistent flange dimension throughout.
3. The backplate material shall be compounded from virgin ABS containing 60% styrene, 20% rubber and 20% acrylic. It shall contain ultra violet inhibitors and stabilizers for protection against ultra violet degradation. The backplate must meet a falling dart impact test of 16 ft/lb.
4. The internal shapes and dimensions shall match various manufactured signal heads.
5. Retroreflective sheeting must be Type XI and comply with ASTM D4956. Retroreflective sheeting must have class 1, 3, or 4 adhesive backing. The adhesive backing must be pressure sensitive and fungus resistant. Retroreflective sheeting must be applied at the fabrication plant under the retroreflective sheeting manufacturer's instruction without appreciable stretching, tearing or other damage.

Backplates. City of Los Angeles Department of Transportation. Approved October 20, 2025. Drawing No. S-77.8A.

title: Mast Arm Mounted Street Name Signs
summary: Standard layouts for mast arm mounted street name signs and freeway ramp signs. Street name signs use white 8-inch upper case and 6-inch lower case Series E letters on a blue background. Freeway ramp signs use Series D letters on a Warboys green background with an 18-inch high route shield.

sheets.notes:
A. Street name signs
Examples: Jefferson Bl; Mulholland Dr / Valley Circle Bl. Dimensions shown: 12" and 18" sign heights, 30" length, 12" and 7" dimensions. Street name signs as required (see Note 4).

Notes:
1. Legend size: 8" upper case, 6" lower case, Series "E" letters.
2. Color: white legend, blue background.
3. 11-1/4" x 12-3/4" one-line arrow.
4. Reflectivity: high intensity letters on super engineer grade background or reverse screening on high intensity sheeting.
5. Where the length of the sign blade would exceed 96" (generally 16 letters and spaces) the street name titles, "ST", "AVE", "BL", "PL", "DR", "RD", etc. may be deleted.

B. Freeway ramp signs
Example: Interstate (405) North, 72" length.
1. Legend size: 8" and 6" Series D capital letters. 11-1/4" x 24" by 12-3/4" one-line arrow. 18" high US, California or Interstate shield, as appropriate with proportional numbers.
2. Color: white legend, Warboys green (L.A. No. 1) background. Black on white US shield. White on green California shield. White on blue and red Interstate shield.
3. Reflectivity: high intensity letters on super engineer grade or reverse screening on high intensity sheeting.

Mast Arm Mounted Street Name Signs. City of Los Angeles Department of Transportation. Approved March 4, 2005. S-486.0, sheet 1 of 2.

title: Mast Arm Street Name Sign Bracket Type 1
summary: Product details for the M10J-OCB250AL adjustable length swing sign bracket and the M10J-OCB250FL fixed length non-adjustable swing sign bracket used to hang street name signs from signal mast arms. Both are aluminum 6061T6 with stainless steel components. Notes give the supplier, 12 inch clearance to adjacent signs and stainless steel banding requirements.

M10J-OCB250AL adjustable length swing sign bracket
All aluminum 6061T6 alloy and stainless steel components. 5/8" from bottom of sign mounting hole to bottom of bracket. Loosen lock nut, adjust bracket teeth to level sign.

M10J-OCB250FL fixed length non-adjustable swing sign bracket
All aluminum 6061T6 alloy and stainless steel components. 9" overall length including axle housing (8" overall length to top of axle housing). 5/8" from bottom of sign mounting hole to bottom of bracket.

Callouts:
1. Pivotal upper bracket.
2. 1" slot for double strapping to electrolier mast arm. Cat. No. M2G-34S(HD) .032" x 3/4" heavy duty stainless steel strap with Cat. No. M2G-34B(HD) buckle recommended.
3. 3/8"-13 x 1 1/2" stainless steel hex head bolt with stainless steel hex lock nut and 3/8" stainless steel washer (both sides). Allows upper bracket to pivot and align with electrolier mast arm. Do not tighten past nut locking feature for pivot action to be operational.
4. 5 5/8" overall length fixed length sign bracket.
5. Stainless steel dampener spring (removable).
6. Stainless steel hex lock nut with 3/8" stainless steel washer. Do not tighten, it binds hinges.
7. 1" O.D. axle housing, 3/8"-13 x 4" stainless steel hex head bolt with 3/8" stainless steel washer. Do not tighten lock nut past locking feature, it binds hinges.
8. Oilite bushing.
9. Sign mounting sets, consisting of two each 5/16"-18 x 1" stainless steel hex head bolt with stainless steel hex lock nut. Two holes on 1 1/2" centers provide positive lock sign mounting to bracket.
10. 7 7/8" overall length upper adjustable sign bracket section.

Notes:
1. Brackets available from: Hawkins Traffic Safety Supply, 1255 Eastshore Highway, Berkeley, CA 94710, (415) 525-4040.
2. If another sign is installed on the mast arm next to the signal head, the street name sign shall be installed with 12" clearance to the edge of that sign.
3. Sign bracket shall be attached to mast arm with 3/4" wide type 201 stainless steel sign banding secured with a banding buckle. Banding shall be 0.020" thick double banded or 0.030" thick single banded.

title: R3-5 Electric Sign
summary: Fiber optic electric sign that displays the R3-5L (left arrow with ONLY) and R3-5R (right arrow with ONLY) lane use messages in lunar white. Messages are formed by fiber optic bundles spaced 0.50 inch center to center, and the sign blanks out completely when not energized. Housing is described on S-58.21 and mounting on S-63.1.4.

sheets.notes:
Dimensions shown: 30" and 13-1/2". Visor enclosure with 2" Rad.

Notes:
1. Sign shall be capable of displaying the following messages:
A: Lunar white - R3-5L (left arrow w/ONLY). Width of arrow - 1.5" stroke.
B: Lunar white - R3-5R (right arrow w/ONLY). Letters are Series "C", 1" stroke.
2. Messages shall be formed with rows of fiber optic bundles spaced 0.50 inch (center to center).
3. Fiber optic bundles shall alternate between two or more lamp sources so that in the event of a lamp failure the sign shall continue to display a discernable and readable message.
4. Sign shall completely blank out when not energized.
5. Door frame, face plate, and interior of housing and visor shall be painted flat black non-reflective finish.
6. Visor enclosure shall be fastened securely to the front frame of the sign.
7. Refer to LADOT Std. Dwg. No. S-63.1.4 for mounting assembly.
8. Sign shall conform to LADOT Specification No. 82-049-03.
9. For housing description, see LADOT Std. Dwg. No. S-58.21.

Messages are yellow on a black background, formed by fiber optic glass bundles. The sign housing has four 3/16 inch drain holes, and housing and mounting are covered by S-58.21 and S-63.1.4.

sheets.notes:
Two sign faces, TRAIN and BUS, each with a 2" Rad. visor enclosure. Overall sign sizes shown: 26.75" and 24" wide. Pedestrian head sign versions shown at smaller size (T=46", L=29"). Notes:

2. Dual rows of fiber optic bundles shall be used to form the word "TRAIN".

4. The front view of the train or bus shall be solid formed by rows of fiber optic glass bundles.
5. The color of the messages shall be yellow. The sign background shall be black.
6. Fiber optic glass bundles shall alternate between two or more lamp sources. In the event of a lamp failure, the sign shall continue to display a readable and discernable message.
7. Sign housing shall be equipped with four (4) 3/16" drain holes at the bottom.
8. The visor enclosure shall be fastened securely to the front frame of the sign.
9. Housing shall contain 4 1/2" x 4 1/2" x 1/4" reinforcement plate located on the top and bottom for use with the Pelco Astro-Brac installation.
10. Refer to Std. Dwg. No. S-63.1.4 for the mounting assembly.
11. Sign shall conform to LADOT Specification No. 82-049-03.
12. For housing description see LADOT Std. Dwg. No. S-58.21.

title: Transit Priority Unit Cabinet Detail - Rear View with Harness Connections
summary: Rear view of the controller cabinet showing the connections for the transit priority unit: DB9 serial cable, C20 transit harness, C2 ATSAC harness, input file harness and TBO. Notes give the port connections for the 2070 cable and the C20 harness and the input file harness route from TBO to the input file backplane.

sheets.notes:
Controller cabinet - rear view. Labels: DB9 serial cable (see Note 1), C20 harness (see Note 3 - transit), C2 harness (ATSAC), input file harness, TBO (see Note 2), C20S and C1S ports, power cable, see sheet.

Notes:
1. Connect 2070 cable end to the 2070 C21S port.
2. Install input file harness from TBO to input file backplane.
3. Connect C20 harness to the C20S port.

Transit Priority Unit Cabinet Detail. City of Los Angeles Department of Transportation. Drawing No. S-70.35A.
